name: Ever Ohms Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ever Ohms Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electronic components in Taiwan and internationally. It offers various chip resistors. The company also provides thick films, arrays, thin films, metal films, metal strips, metal foils, metal shunts, automotives, fusible, MELF, and inductors. Its products are used in automotive, power and energy, computer, mobile device, and communication product applications. Ever Ohms Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
